title: Getting Started
subtitle: From your first ore to the endgame

entries.title: Mod Overview
entries.summary: What this mod is about, on one page

blocks.text: <hl>Kuva Lich</hl> is a Warframe-inspired combat and progression mod: mine, hunt, crack a puzzle that belongs to you alone, then defeat the boss {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} for powerful weapons and upgrade cards.
These upgrade cards are called mods, and they fit into any weapon: vanilla swords and bows, or weapons from other mods.
How a Round Plays

items: Mine: break {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} with a {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed} pickaxe to collect Requiem cards and materials.
Hunt: kill {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s for decryption progress. Progress comes in three stages; each one reveals an answer card.
Set the cards: place three Requiem cards in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} in the order you think is right.
Confront: kill a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} yourself. The right order means decryption succeeds; a wrong one raises your Lich level by 1, and you try another order.
Upgrade: use the Kuva weapons, mods and materials you earn to consecrate gear, install mods and fuse weapons at the utility blocks.
Next round: after a success the answer is rolled again, and the Kuva weapons you get from then on are higher level.

blocks.text: The Tutorial Path
From the next page on, this section is a full tutorial. Keep pressing “Next” at the end of each page and you will learn every feature in the order you meet it in play.

rows: Enchant a pickaxe, mine Requiem Ore
Set the answer, confront the Lich
Rewards, your Kuva weapon, utility blocks

blocks.text: After the tutorial come three quick-reference pages: [[start/materials]], [[start/faq]] and “Numbers at a Glance”. The other sections cover each system in full, and every chapter points to them at the end.
This book uses quite a few terms from Warframe. Never played it? No problem: the tables below explain in one line what each term means in this mod. Click “More” for the full page.

blocks.text: “Lich” originally means an undead sorcerer who returns from death. The Kuva Lich comes back from death too: you execute a Kuva Larvling, and it rises again as a nemesis all your own.

entries.title: Ch. 1 · Mining Requiem Ore
entries.summary: Enchant a pickaxe, mine your first ore

blocks.text: Goal: get a pickaxe with {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed} and mine your first {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore}. Everything in this mod starts with this ore.
What to Do

items: Get the enchantment: {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed} is Very Rare and only shows up near the top of the enchanting table. Librarian villagers may also sell the book; apply it at an anvil.
Pick a pickaxe: diamond or netherite mines fastest. No Silk Touch - with it you get nothing. Fortune does not matter.

items.text: Find the ore: {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} sits in stone and deepslate between Y {cfg:ore_gen.requiemOreMinHeight} and {cfg:ore_gen.requiemOreMaxHeight}, most common in the middle. None in the Nether or the End.

items: Dig: with the enchantment each block takes about 0.5 s. Each one has a {cfg:kuva_lich.cardDropChanceWithEnchant|pctv} chance to pay out, dropping everything in the table below at once.

blocks.text: What You Get

items: kuvalich:khra
kuvalich:jahu
kuvalich:fass
kuvalich:lohk
kuvalich:netra
kuvalich:vome
kuvalich:xata
kuvalich:ris
blocks.caption: The 8 Requiem cards

blocks.text: Mine any {item:kuvalich:experience_ore} you pass too: a stone pickaxe is enough. It drops experience and has a 50% chance of {item:kuvalich:endo} (used to level mods in Ch. 5).
Mine any {item:kuvalich:experience_ore} you pass too: a stone pickaxe is enough, and it drops experience.

blocks.title: Two pitfalls
blocks.text: ① You can mine without the enchantment, but it is painfully slow (about <t>2.5</t> minutes per block with diamond), the payout chance is only <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseCardDropChance|pctv}</t>, and Fortune makes it <w>lower</w>. ② The ore itself drops no block; cards and materials all come from the payout roll. XP ignores the roll: break it with a diamond pickaxe or better for <t>50-100</t> XP, multiplied by <g>{cfg:kuva_lich.expMultiplier|x}</g> with Requiem Destroyed.

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[world/requiem_ore]] · [[world/enchantments]] · [[world/experience_ore]]
Goal: kill {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s for decryption progress and reveal answer cards. Along the way, collect {item:kuvalich:requiem_gem}s and build a {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate}.
Every player has a puzzle of their own: the answer is 3 Requiem cards in a fixed order. The more progress you build, the more answer cards you see.
What to Do

items.text: Find Thralls: they spawn in the dark in the Overworld like zombies (not on mushroom islands). They are big, so low caves rarely have them.

items: Kill them yourself: each one gives {cfg:kuva_lich.minDecryptionProgress}-{cfg:kuva_lich.maxDecryptionProgress} decryption progress. You must land the final blow - melee or arrows both work.
Watch progress: every time you gain progress, a bar pops up at the top of the screen with “Clue N/3” and your current points.
Build a Requiem Gate: {item:kuvalich:requiem_gem} ×5 + Obsidian ×4 (recipe below). Right-click it to see your progress and revealed cards too.
Fill three stages: reach {cfg:kuva_lich.firstStage} / {cfg:kuva_lich.secondStage} / {cfg:kuva_lich.thirdStage} points in turn; each stage reveals one answer card.

blocks.text: What You Get

items: Answer cards: shown in the clue slots on the Gate's bottom row. Their positions are random and do not show the order.

{item:kuvalich:requiem_gem}: only Thralls drop it, at {cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemBaseChance|pctv} plus {cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemLootingBonus|pctv} per level of Looting on your main-hand weapon. You will need a lot for blocks later.
Other drops: a chance of {item:kuvalich:kuva}, {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} and mods.

blocks.title: You can try once the first card shows
blocks.text: The full answer is fixed the moment the first answer card is revealed. From then on you can try at any time (next chapter); more revealed cards just make it easier to guess.

blocks.title: Two pitfalls
blocks.text: ① A Thrall finished off by a pet, lava, burning, or elemental damage such as Toxin, Gas, Electricity or Blast gives no progress and no drops. ② Requiem Gems only use Looting on your main hand - Fortune does nothing, and a bow kill counts as Looting 0.

blocks.title: After the first card, careful what you pick up
blocks.text: From then on, every stack you pick up off the ground has a <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.confiscationChance|pctv}</t> chance to be confiscated whole by the Lich, returned only after a successful decryption. See [[requiem/confiscation]].

{lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s do not appear in the wild. Decryption progress comes from killing a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} instead, each giving <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.masterPotionMultiplier|x}</t> a Thrall's progress.

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[requiem/decryption]] · [[enemies/kuva_slave]] · [[requiem/requiem_items]]

entries.title: Ch. 3 · Confronting the Lich
entries.summary: Set the answer, kill the Lich yourself

blocks.text: Goal: put three Requiem cards into the {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} in the order you guess, then kill a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} yourself. The right order means decryption succeeds.
What to Do

items: Get the three cards: you must actually own the three kinds in the answer. They drop at random from mining, or build a {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast} and turn any 3 cards into 1 random card (building it uses up a Requiem Gate, so make another).
Set the cards: open the Gate and put the cards in the top three slots (left to right = positions 1, 2, 3). Closing the screen saves them.

items.text: Find a Lich: it spawns in the dark in the Overworld like Thralls, but taller. Later, a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum} lets you summon one directly.
Find a Lich: it spawns in the dark in the Overworld like Thralls, but taller.
Summon a Lich: it does not appear in the wild; summon one with a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}.

items: Kill it yourself: you must land the final blow. The answer is checked the moment it dies.

blocks.text: What Happens on the Kill

rows: Not an attempt - you just get decryption progress
<g>Decryption succeeds</g>: rewards drop (next chapter) and the round resets
Decryption fails: Lich level +1; cards lose no durability, and you still get progress

cells: Per Lich level: Kuva enemies hitting you
+{cfg:kuva_lich.increaseDamage|pct}, only from Thralls and Liches; other damage is unaffected
Per Lich level: you hitting Kuva enemies
-{cfg:kuva_lich.reducedDamage|pct}, capped at 99.9%; other targets are unaffected

blocks.text: Guessed Wrong? How to Retry
On a failure the chat tells you if position 1 was right, and adds a second line if positions 1 and 2 were both right. <w>No message = position 1 is wrong</w>.

Once all three cards are revealed: try any order first. If position 1 is right, swap the last two; if not, move another card into position 1. This way you fail at most 3 times, and the 4th try always wins.
Tips for the Fight

items: Bring two or three kinds of damage: rotate melee, bow and spells. Keep hitting with one kind and the Lich resists it more and more.
Bows first: arrows deal ×1.25 damage to Kuva enemies.
Leave pets behind: every attack the Lich makes also hits other creatures within 3 blocks - pets and teammates included.
Pick a safe arena: rewards drop where the Lich dies, so don't finish it next to lava or the void.

items.text: Finish fast: in combat its damage grows by {cfg:kuva_lich.battleBoost|pct} every second - the longer the fight, the harder it hits.

blocks.title: Two pitfalls
blocks.text: ① Filling all three slots before a single answer card is revealed always fails. ② Unsure? Take one card out first: with an empty slot, a Lich kill only adds progress and never counts as a failure.

blocks.text: [[requiem/requiem_gate]] · [[requiem/decrypt_failure]] · [[enemies/kuva_master]] · [[enemies/lich_tactics]]

entries.title: Ch. 4 · Rewards & Blocks
entries.summary: Rewards, your Kuva weapon, new blocks

blocks.text: Goal: collect your decryption rewards, get to know your first Kuva weapon, then use the {item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary} to build a {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}.
What You Get

cells: <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.requiemUltimatumDropChance|pctv}</t> chance for 1; right-click to summon a Lich

rows: Back to your inventory; each card lasts 3 successes

blocks.text: Apart from the cards that return to your inventory, rewards <w>drop where the Lich died</w> - pick them up quickly.
Revealing Mods
Dropped mods are unrevealed and show no stats. Right-click one in your main hand: it turns into a specific mod that drops at your feet. Just pick it up.
Your Kuva Weapon

rows: The number at the end of the line under the item name; it sets attack, attack speed and passive strength
One of 7 at random; element damage = weapon level %
Comes already consecrated, so it takes mods right away
Hover to see it; hold SHIFT, CTRL or ALT for different views

blocks.title: Levels keep rising - keep old ones
blocks.text: A new character's weapon level range is <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMinimumLevel}-{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMaximumLevel}</t>, so your first Kuva weapon rolls somewhere in there. Each later success raises the range until it hits its cap; keep old weapons as fusion material (Ch. 9).
Building the Utility Blocks
The five utility blocks form a crafting chain: each one <w>consumes the block before it</w>. The last three also need a {item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary}, which is why you can only build them now.

blocks.title: Spend your first Reliquary on the Forge
blocks.text: The full set of five blocks needs <t>5</t> Lich Reliquaries, and each success drops only 1. Consecrating and most upgrades happen in the Requiem Forge, so build it first.

blocks.title: Two pitfalls
blocks.text: ① Each tier eats the one before it: building an Arsenal uses up your Requiem Forge, so to keep both you need to build another Forge. ② Break utility blocks with a diamond pickaxe or better, or they simply vanish.

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[weapons/kuva_weapons]] · [[weapons/weapon_level]] · [[weapons/weapon_panel]] · [[enemies/kuva_master]]

entries.title: Ch. 5 · Installing Mods
entries.summary: Reveal, install and level up mods

blocks.text: Goal: install mods on your Kuva weapon, and learn to level them up and deal with spares.

Mods are swappable upgrade cards, each with a few <t>stats</t>, such as “+120% {lang:kuvaweapon.item_attribute_type.meleeDamage}”. Installing costs nothing, and you can take them out and swap them any time.
How to Install

items: Reveal unrevealed mods first by right-clicking them in your main hand.
Open the {item:kuvalich:requiem_weapon_table} and put your Kuva weapon in the weapon slot at the bottom; the 8 mod slots above become usable.
Put a mod in an empty slot to install it, take it out to remove it - <g>nothing is consumed</g>. Shift + left-click in your inventory places it automatically.
Take the weapon out: the mods are now stored on it and work wherever you take it.

blocks.text: Won't Fit?

items: Only one of each mod: the normal and Prime versions count as the same mod.
Different mods that boost the same stat may also conflict. When you pick up a mod, conflicting slots flash red.
At most 1 Riven mod per item.
Weapon mods and Warframe mods don't fit in each other's Arsenal.

blocks.text: Rarity and Sources

rows: Random drops from Requiem Ore and Kuva Thralls

blocks.text: Of the mods that drop, <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|pctv}</t> are weapon mods and the rest are Warframe mods (Ch. 7).
Levelling Up Mods
Mods have levels: effect = max-level value × level ÷ <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleMaxLevel}</t>. A freshly revealed mod is usually level 1, only 1/{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleMaxLevel} of its full value.

items: Open the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}, put a mod in the left slot and {item:kuvalich:endo} in the middle slot.
The mod appears one level higher in the right slot; <g>the Endo is only spent when you take it</g>.
One level at a time - put the new mod back in the left slot to keep going.

rows: Put a single mod in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast}

blocks.text: Mods have no levels: every mod works at full strength as soon as you get it.
Spare Mods

items: Three-into-one: put 3 Bronze, Silver or Gold weapon mods of the same rarity in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast} to get 1 unrevealed mod of that rarity.

items.text: Warframe mods work the same way, but can't be mixed with weapon mods.
Dismantle: put in a single mod to turn it into {item:kuvalich:endo}. Higher rarity and level give more.

blocks.text: Press <t>Tab</t> in either Arsenal to open the mod Codex, which lists every mod at max level (Rivens excluded).
With an unconsecrated item in your main hand, mods do nothing at all. Kuva weapons come consecrated; for other weapons, see the next chapter.

blocks.title: Don't fill up on level 1 mods
blocks.text: A level 1 mod gives only 1/{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleMaxLevel} of its full value. Rather than a pile of level 1 mods, spend Endo raising two or three key mods first.

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[modules/module_overview]] · [[modules/module_rarity]] · [[modules/module_level]] · [[weapons/requiem_recast]] · [[modules/module_codex]]
Goal: consecrate a vanilla or modded weapon so it can take mods too, and reroll its panel with {item:kuvalich:forma} if you don't like it.
Consecrating

items: Open the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}. Put a single item in the left slot (sword, axe, bow, crossbow…) and a {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} in the middle slot.
1 Sliver is spent at once and the consecrated item appears in the right slot, now with a random stat <t>panel</t>.
Take it to the {item:kuvalich:requiem_weapon_table} and install mods, just like a Kuva weapon.

blocks.text: The panel has four stats: {lang:kuvalich.attr.short.damage}, {lang:kuvalich.attr.short.criticalStrikeProbability}, {lang:kuvalich.attr.short.criticalStrikeMultiplier} and {lang:kuvalich.attr.short.triggerChance}. {lang:kuvalich.attr.short.damage} below 100% counts squared: 80% is really 64%.

header: Share of its mods lent to your main hand

blocks.text: Forma: Rerolling the Panel

items: Craft {item:kuvalich:forma}, 3 at a time (recipe below).
In the Requiem Forge, put a consecrated non-Kuva weapon in the left slot and a Forma in the middle slot.
1 is spent at once and the rerolled weapon appears in the right slot, with its installed mods untouched. Not happy? Reroll again.

blocks.title: Rerolling can lock the weapon
blocks.text: Each reroll has a {cfg:kuva_lich.formaLockChance|pctv} chance to lock the weapon for good: normal Forma can no longer reroll it, and only {item:kuvalich:shadow_forma} (Creative inventory only) can undo that.

blocks.title: Two pitfalls
blocks.text: ① A Kuva weapon's panel is fixed - Forma and Riven Slivers do nothing to it. ② An item can't be consecrated twice; to change its panel, use Forma.
In the original game, Forma changes the polarity of an equipment mod slot, at the cost of resetting that equipment's rank to 0. This mod borrows the name for a panel reroll.

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[weapons/requiem_evolve]] · [[weapons/forma]] · [[modules/multi_slot]]

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[weapons/requiem_evolve]] · [[weapons/forma]]
Goal: build a {item:kuvalich:requiem_warframe_table} and install Warframe mods on yourself. They are always active - no need to hold anything or wear armour.
Here, the “Warframe” simply means you, the player. Warframe mods and weapon mods don't fit in each other's Arsenal.
What to Do

items: Build the Warframe Arsenal: {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve} + {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} ×4 + {item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary} + Obsidian ×3. <w>It uses up a Requiem Forge</w>.
Right-click it: the 8 slots in the top two rows are your Warframe mod slots.
A mod works the moment you put it in and stops the moment you take it out.

blocks.text: Warframe mods come from the same places as weapon mods: of the mods dropped by ore, Thralls and Liches, <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|mul:-1|add:100|pctv}</t> are Warframe mods.
What You Get

items: Permanent bonuses such as health, armour, movement speed, resistances and mining speed. Identical stats across the eight mods mostly just add up.
The mods are stored on you: any Warframe Arsenal shows your own set, and you don't lose them on death.

items.text: Shields: stacking {lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.shield} gives you yellow hearts that take hits first. After you take or deal damage, if they aren't empty, they start refilling in about 10 seconds.

blocks.title: Two pitfalls
blocks.text: ① {lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.armor} multiplies the armour you already have - with no armour on, any percentage is still 0. ② {lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.health}, {lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.armor}, {lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.sprintSpeed} and a few others round down in 10% steps: +25% really gives +20%.
In the original game, a Warframe is a biomechanical combat suit the player controls, and Warframes and weapons each have their own mod slots. This mod makes the “Warframe” you, the player.

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[warframe/warframe_table]] · [[warframe/warframe_module]] · [[warframe/shield]] · [[reference/warframe_attr_survival]]
Goal: understand the most common kinds of mod stats - crits, elements, kill stacks and bane - so you know what to stack on your weapon.
Weapon mod effects only apply while a <t>consecrated</t> weapon is in your main hand; unconsecrated weapons work like vanilla.
Crits

items: Crit chance above 100% isn't wasted: it upgrades the crit tier, yellow ×M → orange ×2M → red ×3M (M is the crit multiplier).
Beyond 300%, more chance gives no extra benefit.
Fully charge your melee swings: an uncharged swing scales crit chance down with the charge, and damage drops even harder - a half-charged swing deals only about a fifth of a full-charge hit.
Crits only multiply the physical part; elemental damage never crits.

blocks.text: Elements

items: Element stats add elemental damage to every hit; when they <t>trigger</t>, they also apply that element's status effect to the target.

Two basic elements combine into a compound one, e.g. {lang:kuvaweapon.type.fire} + {lang:kuvaweapon.type.poison} = {lang:kuvaweapon.type.gas}. Which ones pair up depends on their order in the mod slots.
Kuva weapons have a built-in element; ordinary weapons rely on element mods.

blocks.text: Kill Stacks

Stats marked “Gained on kill” add 1 stack per kill. Without new kills they drop one stack at a time: every <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.weaponStackDecayTicks|sec}</t> for weapons and every <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.warframeStackDecayTicks|sec}</t> for Warframe mods. Stacks from Warframe mods work with any weapon, consecrated or not.
Bane
Bane stats (players often call them “discrimination”) make you hit one type of mob harder. Thralls and Liches are both <t>undead</t>, so stack {lang:item.module.bane_of_undead} against them.

blocks.title: Damage numbers
blocks.text: The numbers that pop up on a hit show the health actually lost: white is no crit, and <c:FFFF55>yellow</c> / <c:FFAA00>orange</c> / <c:FF5555>red</c> are the three crit tiers. See [[combat/damage_numbers]].

blocks.title: Two pitfalls
blocks.text: ① If the weapon itself has no element at all, no status chance will ever trigger. ② Mobs finished off by elemental damage over time, Electricity or Blast don't count as your kills and add no stacks.

blocks.title: Learn more
blocks.text: [[combat/damage]] · [[combat/crit]] · [[combat/elements]] · [[combat/element_status]] · [[combat/kill_stack]] · [[combat/bane]]
Goal: consecrate TACZ guns and install mods on them. With a spare {item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary}, you can also permanently upgrade a gun.
Goal: consecrate TACZ guns and install mods on them.
What to Do

items: In the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}, put a gun in the left slot (just one) and a {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} in the middle slot to get a consecrated gun.
Put it in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_weapon_table} and install up to 8 mods.
Fire with the gun in your main hand - the mods apply straight away.

blocks.text: Which Stats Work on Guns

items: <g>Work</g>: ranged damage, ranged crits, elements, status, bane, kill stacks, plus a set of gun-only stats.
Don't work when shooting: melee stats - a bullet hit is not melee.

blocks.text: Lich Enhancement: Permanent Upgrades

items: Gun in the Forge's left slot, {item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary} in the middle: 1 is spent and the gun's base damage rises by <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.taczGunEnhancePercent|round:4|pct}</t> for good.
No consecration needed - any TACZ gun can be upgraded. Put the gun back in the left slot to upgrade again.

items.text: Each gun can be upgraded at most <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.taczGunEnhanceMaxCount}</t> times.

blocks.text: An unconsecrated gun gets no mod effects at all, and mods on your offhand or armour can't reach it either.

blocks.text: [[tacz/tacz_overview]] · [[tacz/tacz_gun_attributes]] · [[tacz/tacz_enhance]]

entries.title: Ch. 9 · Loops & Endgame
entries.summary: Grow every round: levels, fusion, Rivens

blocks.text: Goal: see what to chase after each round: higher-level Kuva weapons, weapon fusion, and Riven mods with good stats.
What Changes Each Round

items: A success resets your decryption progress, the answer and your Lich level; the next round's answer is rolled again.

Both ends of your weapon level range rise by the same random amount (<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevelCapIncrease}</t>-<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevelCapIncrease}</t> levels), so later Kuva weapons are stronger.
The range has caps: the minimum tops out at <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevel}</t>, the maximum at <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevel}</t>. Beyond that, only fusion helps.
Each Requiem card lasts 3 successes. Put old cards in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast}: 3 of them make 1 new card.

blocks.text: Fusing Kuva Weapons

items: In the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}, put your main weapon in the left slot and another Kuva weapon in the middle (it can be a different kind).
Take the result from the right slot: the two become one.

blocks.text: New level = round down[ higher of the two levels × {cfg:kuva_lich.upgradeMultiplier|add:1} ], max {cfg:kuva_lich.upgradeLimit}

items: The result keeps the left weapon's type, panel and mods.
<w>Its element becomes the middle weapon's</w>. To give your main weapon a new element, put a weapon with that element in the middle.
The middle weapon disappears along with its mods - take good mods off first.

blocks.text: Riven Mods: Rerolling Stats

items: Put a revealed Riven mod in the Forge's left slot and enough {item:kuvalich:kuva} in the middle. The card shows how many this cycle costs.

A card with new stats appears in the right slot at once - <w>this is when you pay for this cycle</w>. Every preview costs Kuva: change the amount in the middle slot afterwards and it previews again and charges again.
Want the new stats? Take it. Want the old ones? Take the original back - Kuva already paid is not refunded. So every reroll has a price.

blocks.text: In the original game, Riven mods have fully random stats that you can reroll (“cycle”) again and again with Kuva. More disposition dots mean a less popular weapon and stronger Riven stats.
Other Ways to Get Stronger

items.text: Level your key mods to the max (Ch. 5).

items: Unique enchantments: {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.lethal} and {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.first_strike} (swords), {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.escort} and {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.death_resistance} (armour), {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.experience_collector} (tools).

items.text: The Warframe stat “{lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.itemDropMultiplier}” gives more drops from mobs.
The Warframe stat “{lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.oreDropMultiplier}” gives more drops from ores.

items: {item:kuvalich:machete}: kill an animal or monster with it in your main hand and each drop stack becomes 1-3 times as large.

blocks.title: Requiem Gems only come from Thralls
blocks.text: You can't mine a {item:kuvalich:requiem_gem} - only {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s drop them. The bonus uses Looting on your main-hand weapon, not Fortune. The block chain eats a lot of gems, so hunt plenty of Thralls.

blocks.title: Reliquaries also upgrade guns
blocks.text: Put a TACZ gun and a {item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary} into the Requiem Forge to raise the gun's base damage by <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.taczGunEnhancePercent|pct}</t> for good. See [[tacz/tacz_enhance]].

entries.title: Common Pitfalls
entries.summary: The mistakes new players make most

blocks.text: The traps new players fall into most often. Each entry names the mistake first, then what is actually true.
Mining and Blocks

items: × Mining Requiem Ore without the enchantment: about 150 s per block with a diamond pickaxe, a payout chance of only {cfg:kuva_lich.baseCardDropChance|pctv}, and Fortune makes it lower. With the enchantment it's about 0.5 s per block at {cfg:kuva_lich.cardDropChanceWithEnchant|pctv}.
× Mining ores with Silk Touch: neither Requiem Ore nor Experience Ore drops anything - not even the block itself.
× Breaking utility blocks with an iron pickaxe: all five need a diamond pickaxe or better, or they vanish. The Requiem Gate, Recast and Forge are also very slow to mine without Requiem Destroyed.

blocks.text: Decryption and the Lich

items: × Thinking the Gate eats your cards: cards are only registered to you and can be taken back any time, from any Requiem Gate. Only a successful decryption costs each card 1 durability (3 in total); failures cost nothing.
× Taking the clue slots as the order: revealed answer cards land in random positions, so you have to test the order. A {item:kuvalich:requiem_riddle} tells you the right order directly.

× Fighting Liches with cards you're unsure of: while all three slots are full, every Lich kill is checked, and a wrong guess adds 1 Lich level; filling them before the first stage clears always fails. If in doubt, take one card out - then a Lich kill only adds progress.
× Letting pets or summons clear mobs: decryption progress and Thrall / Lich drops only count kills you make yourself; arrows you shoot count.
× Expecting this round's answer to carry over: every success wipes progress, the answer and your Lich level, and the next round is rolled fresh.

× Spamming one attack on the Lich: each hit of the same damage type gives it +5% resistance (up to 30%); the more hits within 2 seconds, the less each does (down to 40%); any part of one hit above 15% of its max health is heavily reduced. Mix damage types - see [[enemies/lich_resistance]].

items.text: × Thinking the Lich level is just a number: each level makes damage from Thralls and Liches +{cfg:kuva_lich.increaseDamage|pct}, so every failure makes them harder (falls, ordinary mobs and other damage are unaffected). It resets on a successful decryption.

× Thinking the Lich level doesn't touch your damage: each level makes your damage to Thralls and Liches -{cfg:kuva_lich.reducedDamage|pct} (capped at 99.9%); other targets are unaffected. It resets on a successful decryption.

× Leaving valuables on the ground: once the first answer card is revealed, every stack you pick up has a {cfg:kuva_lich.confiscationChance|pctv} chance to be confiscated whole (up to {cfg:kuva_lich.maxConfiscatedItems} stacks), returned only on success. Mods you reveal drop at your feet first, so they can be taken too.

blocks.text: Gear and Mods

items: × Installing mods before consecrating: an ordinary weapon must first be consecrated with a {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}. Kuva weapons come consecrated.
× Using Forma on a Kuva weapon: {item:kuvalich:forma} only works on consecrated non-Kuva weapons. Kuva weapons get stronger through fusion.
× Two Rivens on one item: each item (and your Warframe mod loadout) takes only 1 Riven; mods of the same type or that conflict can't be installed together either.

items.text: × Expecting full value from offhand or armour mods: slots other than the main hand apply at their own percentage - see [[modules/multi_slot]].

items: × Farming Thralls with Fortune: mob drops use Looting on your main-hand weapon, and only the {item:kuvalich:requiem_gem} gets a Looting bonus.
× Throwing away early low-level Kuva weapons: they make good fusion material. Note that fusion takes the element of the material weapon, so check its element before putting it in the middle slot.

items.text: × Filling a weapon with level 1 mods: level 1 is only 1/{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleMaxLevel} of the full value. Spend {item:kuvalich:endo} raising two or three key mods first.
